info.name: Weavr Multi Product BackOffice Access Token Sends API

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset value for paging, indicating the initial item number to be returned from the data set satisfying the given criteria. Leave out to fetch the first page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit of the results for paging, starting at the offset. Limit is always capped at 100.

params.name: profileId
params.description: Filter by the Send profile. Leave out to fetch all entries.

params.name: instrumentId
params.description: Filter by the source instrument id.

params.name: source.id
params.description: Filter by the source instrument id. Must be specified when `source.type` is provided.

params.name: source.type
params.description: Filter by the source instrument type. Must be specified when `source.id` is provided.

params.name: state
params.description: Filter by the Send transaction state. Leave out to fetch all states.

params.name: createdFrom
params.description: Filter for send transactions created after `createdFrom` timestamp. Timestamp is expressed in Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision. Leave out to fetch all Send transactions.

params.name: createdTo
params.description: Filter for send transactions created before `createdTo` timestamp. Timestamp is expressed in Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision. Leave out to fetch all Send transactions.

params.name: executedFrom
params.description: Filter for send transactions executed after `executedFrom` timestamp. Timestamp is expressed in Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision. Leave out to fetch all Send transactions.

params.name: executedTo
params.description: Filter for send transactions executed before `executedTo` timestamp. Timestamp is expressed in Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision. Leave out to fetch all Send transactions.

params.name: tag
params.description: Filter by the send tag. The exact tag must be provided, as wildcards are not supported. Leave out to fetch all entries.

items.docs: Retrieves all the send transactions performed by the logged-in identity.

Sends funds between managed accounts and managed cards belonging to *different* corporate or consumer identities.

The Send Profile (configured in the Multi Portal) specified determines the behaviour and restrictions of the transaction (for example, fees).

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the Send transaction.

items.docs: Retrieve the send transaction identified by the `id` path parameter.

params.description: The unique identifier of the Send transaction.

params.name: id

params.name: channel
params.description: The unique identifier for the channel.

info.name: Verify a send using a one-time password

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the send transaction.

params.name: channel
params.description: The unique identifier for the channel.

items.docs:
Deprecated in favour of [Challenges endpoints](#tag/Confirmation-Challenges/operation/multipleSCAVerify)

Completes the verification process for a Send.

If the outcome of the verification is successful, the send is executed.

If not verified challenge expires after 5 minutes and the number of incorrect OTP attempts is limited to reduce the risk of fraud.

_Note that on the Sandbox Environment, text messages are not sent and the `verificationCode` is always \"123456\"._

info.name: Issue a push notification that can be used to verify Send transaction

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the send transaction.

items.docs:
Deprecated in favour of [Challenges endpoints](#tag/Confirmation-Challenges/operation/multipleSCAChallengePush)

Starts the verification process for a Send in which a push notification is sent to a device belonging to the logged-in user that was previously enrolled through the `/authentication_factors/push/{channel}` endpoint.

You should only start this process if the Send transaction `state` is `PENDING_CHALLENGE`.
